helpers.stack_frame_description: SUB sp,sp,#784 at 4000 reserves a fixed 784-byte frame; no ADDVL or scalable spill area exists. X-register saves and integer/pointer locals occupy the frame. STP d8,d9 at 4104 (sp+112), d10,d11 at 4111 (+128), d12,d13 at 4115 (+144), d14,d15 at 4120 (+160), paired with LDP at 5682,5685,5688,5691, are low-64-bit ABI preservation. They are not Z/Q/predicate spills. All three actual returns/tail calls restore exactly 784 bytes at 5708,5823,5854.
helpers.spill_count_scope: Static sites over the entire helper from symbol to .size, including all out-of-line initialization, tails and fallback paths. ABI D saves are excluded and separately listed; no tile vector materialization occurs.
helpers.spill_notes: Reviewed all vector memory operations and all SP-derived aliases. x8=sp+632 at 4002 stores the four external output pointers through integer STP; x2=sp+312 at 4181 reads integer kernel-pointer bookkeeping; x1=sp+664 at 4670 reads integer kernel-pointer bookkeeping; x0=sp+632 at 5553 reloads the external output pointers. The 16 ST1W at 5562..5595 use those loaded output pointers plus column offsets, not SP addresses. All LD1W/LD1RW/LD1RQW addresses lead to input/kernel pointers. No LDR/STR Z, Q or predicate operand, no vector load/store through a derived SP address, and no vector accumulator slot exists. The only vector register memory operations on SP are the four ABI D-register STP/LDP pairs.
helpers.transition_spill_review: The full path and every alternate initialization label were read. input_0 remainder 4312..4339, input_1 copies 4417..4482, input_2 copies 4582..4668 and shared setup 4669..4718 pass live accumulators in Z registers. shared exit 4895..4913 enters the paired remainder without loading any accumulator slots; 5008..5015 selects one-column copies 5016..5070 and 5071..5120, followed by row transition 5121..5131. 5132..5148 restores integer pointers for trailing_0; trailing_0 copies 5229..5315 and trailing_1 copies 5391..5456 keep all accumulators in registers. trailing_2 copies 5507..5551 feed the final 16 external ST1W. .L369 5749..5754, .L328 5755..5763, .L368 5764..5769 and .L392 5879..5899 initialize zero Z registers on bypass paths. No vector spill appears in transitions, zero initialization, output stores, or the horizontal-block pointer update 5596..5678.
helpers.tail_and_fallback_review: kh<=3 branches at 4024 to .L325, which calls rowtriple at 5842 then restores its fixed frame and tail-calls prefix at 5863 for the fourth row using 3*stride. Width below CNTB (4*CNTW float outputs) branches 4033 to .L389, then .L327 selects the horizontal remainder. .L391 passes current column i, remaining ow-i and original stride to rowtriple (5803), then restores its frame before prefix (5831). No live vector output must survive these calls. For shared rows, kw<=3 branches 4690 to .L370, which sets ik=0 at 5740 and bypasses all LD1RQW via .L341; the four-column loads only execute when four coefficient columns remain. Pair/unpaired paths preserve source order and existing bounded input windows. kh5 was not dynamically covered by this diagnostic; these are actual assembly/source observations, not added test coverage.

codegen_comparison.notes: Root directly read C49 actual .L342 lines4719..4894 and original frozen C45 shared evidence. C49 contains175 machine instructions versus185 in C45. C49 advances through completed q0/q1/q2 accumulator sets before the following packed-coefficient lane use; this is a changed arithmetic/input liveness schedule, not only register renaming. Full helper and transitions remain separately reviewed by the assigned reviewer; compiler fences emit no hardware instruction and cannot be assigned invented PCs.
